verdict.rationale: Highnote documents an integrated ledger that tracks money movement and balances, posts transactions in real time, and is reachable via its GraphQL API and webhooks. It also claims reconciliation on the same core ledger and says its in-house teams handle daily reconciliation and settlement. None of this evidence describes consumable reconciliation artifacts such as settlement files or report APIs for interchange, fees, or network adjustments. Missing for 10: documented daily settlement or reconciliation files, report APIs that break out interchange, fees and network adjustments, file formats or delivery mechanisms, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
